title: Banks Have Had It Up to Here With Your AI Agent
summary: Major US financial institutions are banning third-party bots from logging into your accounts—and warning that any costly bot mistakes are strictly your problem.
llm_summary: U.S. banks are drawing a hard line against third‑party AI bots that log into customers’ accounts, saying they won’t tolerate unauthorized access and will hold users responsible for any errors or losses those bots cause. The move reflects growing concerns that “AI agents” can make costly mistakes, so banks are now banning them outright and warning customers that any damage is on the account holder, not the institution.
